a.xlink:title: On the first show: offers recovery and the case chooser, then the privacy and update questions.
True when QEGTRAIN_PLAYBACK_PROFILE was "1" when the profiler was created.
The one set of hooks of the process: free functions read it, and main builds one MainWindow.
A file was asked to be opened. path is as the request named it.
Runs the scene that the window holds, if it is not running already.
Shows the case chooser with the bundled and the recent scenes, and acts on the choice.
The profiler of the process, created at the first call.
The text that tells the user about record.
Stores version as "X.Y.Z" under "updates/failedVersion".
The version as "X.Y.Z".
Compares the installed version with the version that the record names.
Asks to review the run, prepares the scene, builds the canvas and starts the simulation.
Seconds since midnight of an "hh:mm:ss" base time; 0 when the text is empty or not a time of day.
Stores the settings of the run and its window length. Does nothing unless enabled().
The number of diagnostics of each severity.
The message of the first error among the diagnostics, else of the first diagnostic,...
True when a diagnostic has severity Error.
The next run writes to the folder of the scene sceneName, unless the user chose a folder.
Starts the run on a worker thread. The scene has to be prepared.
The scenario of a case that stores none: id "baseline", no incidents and no entrance delays.
The first error among the diagnostics, else the first diagnostic, else null.
Empties run.infra, the platforms of the run and its final-station statistics.
The paths of the recent scenes as the settings keep them, newest first. Spellings of one path appear ...
